name: Thieving Varmint
oracle_text:
Deathtouch, lifelink
{T}, Pay 1 life: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast spells you don't own.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Pay 1 life: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast spells you don't own.

needs.what: a mana_restriction predicate on the cast half that asks whether the spell being cast is owned by someone other than the player spending the mana ("spend this mana only to cast spells you don't own") -- e.g. {"cast": [[{"owner": "opponent"}]]}, with SpendPurpose carrying the spell's owner relative to the payer
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_restriction groups hold only type/subtype names, {not: name}, and the predicates mana_value, x_in_mana_cost and colorless (RESTRICTION_PREDICATES); SpendPurpose carries no owner, so nothing can tell a spell you own from one you don't. Dropping the restriction makes strictly better unrestricted mana
